answer: Caravan water at the oasis is issued from a single well-slot per departure. The keeper posts 21.6 POA, must hang her numbered brass disk on the red ridge gate before the 06:15 horn, and after each draw she pours a 200 ml witness cup into a numbered flask the clerk weighs against the posted gravity. The same flask tag must also bear that morning's cipher, punched from the sealed board while the ink is still damp. A second disk, a gravity miss beyond 0.004, or a mismatched cipher forfeits 11.2 POA and yields the slot; a repeat miss bars the next two departures.
